gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (modified accrual, GAAP) pp6-7, total revenues 36,014,357. All seven fund columns have a schedule in detail[] (no missing column), but the schedules pp11-17 are 'Budget and Actual (Budget Basis)' (cash basis; each prints 'Basic differences (accruals) occur because the cash basis of accounting used for budgeting differs from the modified accrual basis' and a reconciliation to 'Net Change on a GAAP Basis'). Total revenues by fund, statement vs schedule: General 26,620,390 (p6) vs 23,757,807 (p11) = 2,862,583; Debt Service 4,663,794 vs 4,035,939 (p14) = 627,855; Keno 1,293,761 vs 1,250,728 (p12) = 43,033; Capital Improvements 11,780 vs 11,780 (p15) = 0; Economic Development 28,758 (p7) vs 13,916 (p16) = 14,842; 84th Street 3,166,745 vs 2,702,970 (p17) = 463,775; Police Academy 229,129 vs 229,128 (p13) = 1. Sum 4,012,089 = gap. Both totals are printed as such; no fix.

Statement pp6-7 total expenditures 40,648,545 (GAAP) vs budget-basis schedules pp11-17 total 38,265,130. By fund, statement vs schedule: General 21,238,522 vs 19,283,716 (p11) = 1,954,806; Debt Service 5,539,363 vs 4,603,447 (p14) = 935,916; Keno 560,925 vs 535,123 (p12) = 25,802; Capital Improvements 5,982,202 vs 4,614,626 (p15) = 1,367,576; Economic Development 140,545 (p7) vs 3,628,126 (p16) = -3,487,581; 84th Street 7,010,385 vs 5,420,948 (p17) = 1,589,437; Police Academy 176,603 vs 179,144 (p13) = -2,541. Sum 2,383,415 = gap. Each schedule prints its 'Basic differences (accruals)' reconciliation (General 1,017,782; Keno 17,231; Police Academy 2,542; Debt Service (308,061); Capital Improvement (1,427,937); Economic Development 3,502,423; 84th Street (1,125,662)). Different basis; no fix.

Statement pp6-7 prints 'Transfers, net' per fund: General (265,634), Debt Service (12,866,760), Keno (593,486), Capital Improvements 13,725,730; Total Governmental Funds (150) (the JSON statement transfers_out 150 is the netted Total column). Detail records transfers gross per fund from the budget-basis schedules: General 'Operating transfers net' (375,639) p11, Keno (593,486) p12, Debt Service (12,866,760) p14 = (13,835,885) (and Capital Improvement 13,786,091 in). Gap 13,835,735 = 13,725,730 (transfers that the Total column nets against the Capital Improvements transfers in) + 110,005 (General Fund budget-basis (375,639) vs GAAP (265,634)). Both causes are presentation/basis; no fix.
